target.command:
cd /home/john/mynotes/deterministic_equidistribution_theory/c_suite/out_kappa
echo "=== lowest-frequency char k=1: exact gap vs annealed |p^(1/phi)| (the finiteness-leak test) ==="
printf "%6s %8s | %-12s | %-22s\n" "Q" "xi=1/phi" "exact gap_s0" "annealed 1-|p^|"
grep -v '^#' fourier_comparison.csv | grep -v '^Q,' | awk -F, '$2==1{
  pi=3.14159265358979323846; ann=1-1/sqrt(5-4*cos(2*pi*$3));
  printf "%6s %.6f | %.5f       | %.6f  -> exact gaps it %s\n",$1,$3,1-$5,ann,(1-$5>ann?"MORE":"less")}'
echo
echo "=== killed-height uniform kappa_Q = 1 - MAX ratio over full group (per Q, s=0) ==="
grep -v '^#' spectral_gaps.csv | grep -v '^Q,L' | awk -F, '$6!="trivial" && $5=="0.0000"{Q=$1; if($17>mx[Q])mx[Q]=$17} END{for(Q in mx)printf "  Q=%-4s kappa_Q=%.4f (max ratio=%.4f)\n",Q,1-mx[Q],mx[Q]}' | sort -t= -k2 -n
